# Micah 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Mobilize your troops! The enemy has laid siege against us. With a rod they strike the ruler of Israel across the face.

**2** But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah — you are only a small village among all the people of Judah. Yet a ruler of Israel, whose origins go back to the distant past, to the days of eternity, will come from you on My behalf.

**3** The people of Israel will be abandoned to their enemies until the woman in labor gives birth. Then the remaining exiles will rejoin their fellow Israelites.

**4** And He will stand and lead His flock with the LORD's strength, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. His people will live there undisturbed, for He will be highly honored around the world.

**5** And He will be the source of peace. When the Assyrians invade our land and break through our defenses, we will appoint seven shepherds and eight leaders to watch over us.

**6** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**7** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**8** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**9** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**10** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**11** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**12** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**13** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**14** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

**15** The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **5:2**: Out of tiny, insignificant Bethlehem — not Jerusalem, not a palace, not a power center — comes the one whose origins stretch back to eternity. God consistently works through what the world overlooks.

- **5:2**: This verse is one of the most specific messianic prophecies in the Old Testament. Seven hundred years before Jesus was born, Micah identified the exact town. The specificity is staggering.

- **5:4-5**: He doesn't just bring peace — He IS peace. And He leads not with political power but as a shepherd, with God's own strength. That's a completely different model of leadership.

— PNEUMA
